full_judgment: 5. The High Court Division upon hearing the parties by judgment and order dated 2nd   March, 2009 made the rule absolute and directed the writ respondents to afford tax holiday to the writ petitioner under section 46A of the Income Tax Ordinance on the basis of its application. The High Court Division observed that the writ petitioner made the application for tax holiday within the period of limitation and that the writ petitioner has been discriminated in considering its case for tax holiday.
